name: Router1
config:
hostname Router1
interface g0/0
 ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
 no shutdown

name: Switch1
config:
hostname Switch1
vlan 10
 name SALES
vlan 20
 name IT

name: Firewall1
config:
hostname Firewall1
access-list 100 permit tcp any any eq 80
access-list 100 permit tcp any any eq 443
access-list 100 deny ip any any
